tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't send a payment because Evergreen Catering (vendor V-267) has two approved invoices, not one, and I don't know which one you mean:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-33547 | $5,876.71 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-90358 | $4,652.13 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

The other two invoices aren't payable: INV-36907 ($4,019.66) is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-57238 ($4,911.58) is already marked paid. No payments have been sent from the operating account yet, so nothing has gone out twice.

Payments can't be undone easily, so I didn't want to guess. Please tell me which invoice to pay, or whether to pay both. Both are under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll pay by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available) with an idempotency key so each invoice is paid exactly once. Then I'll send you the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-90358, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-90358, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-90358 in full by wire from the operating account. The payment went out once, and the invoice now shows as paid.

**Payment details:**
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-90358 (Evergreen Catering, vendor V-267), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $4,652.13, the full invoice amount (under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval)
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent

PAY0001 is the only payment on the account. I used a unique key on the wire so that if it were accidentally resubmitted, it wouldn't pay twice.

I left the disputed invoice, INV-33547 ($5,876.71), alone. It's still listed as approved, so someone could pay it by mistake. You might want to put it on hold or change its status until the dispute is settled.
